verdict.rationale: CloudConvert's API v2 docs state that official SDKs exist for PHP, Node.js, Python, Ruby, Java and .NET, which covers the mainstream-language part of the story directly. Nothing in the pack shows that these SDKs are versioned (release cadence, semver, changelogs) or actively maintained by the vendor, so coverage is incomplete. missing for 10: evidence of SDK versioning/release history, evidence of ongoing vendor maintenance, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As a developer, official client libraries exist for mainstream languages, versioned and maintained by the vendor

citations.quote: For API v2, official PHP, Node.js, Python, Ruby, Java and .NET SDKs are available.
